decision.explanation: The documents present two distinct individuals named Jacques Zaninetta. Document d1 describes a French politician transitioning into retirement, while document d2 introduces 'Father Jacques Zaninetta,' a priest known in the town of Saint-Pierre. These are separate referents with distinct occupations. The claim of 'teacher' (from D2S9) is presented as an uncertain rumor and not directly attributed to Father Jacques Zaninetta, so it is excluded due to lack of direct evidence. Only confirmed occupations from distinct referents are retained.
